clips.title: The story
paras: At Dun Modr, on the Wetlands' northern edge, Motley Garmason leads a desperate defense. The Dark Iron clan holds the town after saboteurs shattered the Thandol Span, leaving the Ironforge Mountaineers with a tenuous line as they wait for reinforcements that may never come.

Dun Modr guarded the southern end of the colossal Thandol Span, the bridge linking Khaz Modan to Lordaeron. Dark Iron saboteurs and demolitionists shattered its archway, severing Alliance travel before they overran the stronghold. Motley Garmason and a handful of surviving defenders withdrew to an observation camp just outside town. Without a counterattack, the northern gateway risks permanent Dark Iron dominion.

Dwarven regiments are deployed to distant Alliance battlefields, leaving Motley's small detachment largely to fend for itself. His scouts try to signal Ironforge for relief, but communications falter and promised reserves remain out of sight. To buy time and disrupt the enemy's entrenchments, Motley orders surgical strikes into Dun Modr's ruins. The aim is to thin the ranks of Dark Iron engineers, tunnelers, and front-line soldiers before they push farther south into the Wetlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: War rages both home and abroad. While mighty Dwarven soldiers give their lives in far off territories in the name of the Alliance, our own lands fall prey to the evil deeds of the Dark Iron Dwarves. They laid waste to the Thandol Span. Dun Modr fell soon after.
We need you to gather force and push the front back. If you can kill 15 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Tunnelers, 5 Saboteurs and 5 Demolitionists, the reserve might arrive in time to finish the drive.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Roggo has been unable to contact the reserve forces. We need offensive pressure on that Dark Iron encampment, adventurer. Now get back out there and serve your duty to King Magni!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You upheld your orders well, adventurer. You have proven yourself to be a valiant soldier and loyal servant to King Magni and for that I salute you! With the pressure you applied to the Dark Iron encampment, we now stand a chance of driving them off our lands for good... If only the damned reserve would show...
